mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism operates without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.05% (the 25th percentile of historical values), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 9.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand and economic activity, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 225), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225 and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 indicates contraction in the manufacturing sector, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO falls below 90, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 600 thousand units signals weak residential construction and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when HOUST falls below 600, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate market reactions to accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.05%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 225 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 225, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
